title: Personalisation
subtitle: Configure the theme, language and keyboard shortcuts for your account.

language.title: Language
language.description: Your display language is saved on this device and applies to the whole app.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: The "Not opened" group contains pages and components you have not opened in this session — open them at least once for their shortcuts to appear here. Each shortcut can use up to 4 keys (at most 3 modifiers + 1 main key).
